name: osv-triage
title: OSV 판정 — 기능 사용 규칙 작성
use: Write usage rules for osv-scanner ids still judged «none» on a target repo, so the next scan can say Invalidated.
rules: The target repo path is given in the request text (--repo). Do not edit, commit, checkout, install or run anything in the target repo; reading its files is allowed. Every write goes through `/usr/bin/python3 scripts/osv_rules.py --append` from the Sidereus repository (this pipeline's repo), which validates and atomically writes ${MAILBOX_DIR:-~/.mailbox-mcp}/arch/osv-rules.json. Never hand-edit that file or any other rule file. Rule JSON: {"name","ids":[...],"any":[fixed strings, 3-80 printable ASCII, at most 20],"globs":[basename fnmatch, at most 12],"src":"https://...","at":"YYYY-MM-DD"}; patterns are fixed strings, never regexes, and any hit means the vulnerable feature is used. Metadata only: never paste code lines, matched text or advisory bodies into the report or the mailbox; ids, package names, pattern strings and URLs are fine.

stages.title: 준비
stages.task: Run `/usr/bin/python3 scripts/osv_rules.py --unjudged --repo <repo>` once from the Sidereus repository. Report the listed ids and packages only. If it lists nothing, report `nothing to judge` and stop: the orchestrator skips the remaining stage. If it fails, report the error line; never treat a failure as an empty list. Change nothing.

stages.title: 트리아지
stages.task: For each id from the previous stage only: read the advisory's preconditions on osv.dev (https://osv.dev/vulnerability/<id>) and its GHSA page. Group ids whose precondition is the same feature. Per group, choose fixed-string patterns that code using the feature would contain (class names, XML tags, annotations, config keys); prefer recall over precision. Write one rule per group: `/usr/bin/python3 scripts/osv_rules.py --append '<rule json>'` with today's date in `at` and the advisory URL in `src`. An id you cannot decide (deployment-dependent precondition, no code signal) gets no rule. Report one line per rule (name, ids) and one line `id — reason` per undecided id. No code lines in the report.
